items.name: DeutschBon – CHF 400 voucher for a German course
items.organisation: Stadt Bern, Fachstelle für Migrations- und Rassismusfragen
items.who_for: Age 18+, German is a foreign language, registered in Stadt Bern or Ostermundigen; S status and sans-papiers allowed; not if asylum social aid already pays a course
items.how_to_access: Lottery of 600 vouchers (+100 Ostermundigen); people with health-insurance premium reduction (IPV) get priority. Registration closed on 2026-11-21; next round autumn 2027.
items.notes: Group courses only (incl. online) at 13 schools; no exam fees. Does not affect residence permit.

items.name: KulturLegi Kanton Bern
items.cost: first year free; renewal CHF 20 (CHF 30 for a couple/family household; free for children up to 18)
items.who_for: Residents of partner communes (Stadt Bern is one) on social aid, AHV/IV supplementary benefits, scholarship, second-highest health-premium reduction (IPV), or wage garnishment; others with low income via tax assessment or previous year's salary statement
items.how_to_access: Social service or AHV branch confirms eligibility; apply online, at Caritas Bern, or by post with passport photo.
items.notes: At least 30% off ~4200 partner offers (health, sport, education, culture), cheaper German courses, shopping at Caritas-Markt. Partner list: https://www.kulturlegi.ch/kanton-bern/angebote ; partner communes: https://www.kulturlegi.ch/kanton-bern/partnergemeinden . The flyer lists no public-transport discount.

items.name: Caritas-Markt – who may shop there
items.who_for: Social aid or AHV/IV supplementary benefits; premium reduction (some regions); income at subsistence minimum; scholarship; refugee status or asylum seeker (N, F, S permit); sans-papiers; KulturLegi holders
items.how_to_access: Personal shopping card: KulturLegi or a Caritas-Markt-Einkaufskarte from the regional Caritas.
items.notes: Bern shop is offices.json id caritas-markt (hours in offices_supplement).

items.name: Bank account with N, F or S permit (link-out)

aufenthaltsraum.opening_hours: Mon-Fri 08:30-11:00, 14:30-16:30; closed Tue afternoon and Sun. Free coffee/tea; soup on Saturday. Leaflet: 'Ab 16.12 geschlossen'.

azzurro.opening_hours: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri café and meal from 11:30 (menu CHF 7); Sun from 15:00; closed Tue and Sat. First Monday of the month: free soup and bread for everyone from 18:00.

la-gare.opening_hours: Mon-Sat 11:00-18:00; meal about 13:30 (register by 12:00), menu CHF 5, soup and bread CHF 2. Meeting point for people with alcohol problems.

dock8.opening_hours: Mon-Wed 09:00-17:00, Thu-Fri 09:00-22:00, Sat-Sun closed; stay without buying anything. Sunday PINTO meal: see help.json pinto-sonntag-znacht.

heiliggeist.opening_hours: Tue-Fri 11:00-18:30, Sun 13:00-17:00; free coffee and tea

sleeper.opening_hours: Registration and check-in 22:00-01:00; wake-up 09:00, leave by 10:00. CHF 5 bed and breakfast.

passantenheim.opening_hours: Sun-Thu until 23:00, Fri-Sat until 24:00; new admissions around the clock only in exceptional cases. 50 beds, CHF 15 incl. breakfast; washing machine, kitchen.

passantenhilfe.opening_hours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 09:00-11:30, 14:00-16:00; Wed 14:00-16:00. Free, anonymity possible.

punkt6.opening_hours: November to April, Mon-Sun 06:00-10:00 and 17:30-22:30. Coffee/tea, showers, laundry, internet, lockers, phone, laptop/printer, sleeping.

gassendusche.opening_hours: Tue-Sat from 09:00, Sun from 10:00; shower CHF 2

sozialdienst.opening_hours: New registrations Mon-Thu 14:00-16:30, Fri 14:00-15:30; Schreibstube (help filling in forms) Mon-Wed 08:30-11:30, Fri 08:30-11:30, closed Thu. Phone 031 321 60 27.

gvsp.opening_hours: Sans-papiers health care: walk in without appointment Mon 13:30-17:00, Tue 13:30-17:00, Fri 08:30-12:00.
gvsp.note: CHF 10 once at first visit, then free (small share for dental care). WhatsApp health chat 079 884 53 55 (answered Mon-Thu). Also in Biel (Haus pour Bienne, Kontrollstrasse 22). Trauma therapy: help.json srk-ambulatorium-folter-kriegsopfer.

isa.opening_hours: Short advice without appointment Mon, Tue, Thu 14:00-17:00; phone advice Mon-Thu 10:00-12:00 on 031 310 12 72.
isa.languages: Azerbaijani, Dari, English, Farsi, French, Italian, Spanish, Turkish, German; others on request

rbs.note: Foreigners/migration law (AIG), social-aid law, racism/ethnic discrimination; for people living in Kanton Bern.

insel-notfall.note: City page gives Rosenbühlgasse 27, 3010 Bern (offices.json has Freiburgstrasse 16c). Children and youth: +41 31 632 92 77.
